purpose: Start one clean implementation-stable report-only V58 observer epoch after the prior resumed window was invalidated by a 4142.35276-second heartbeat gap and source-hash discontinuity.

predecessor_disposition.reuse_policy: Do not pool predecessor route cadence or profitability into this epoch. Separately frozen exact lifecycles remain descriptive only.

validation_sequence: Run one bounded smoke poll in the isolated smoke ledger.
Require eight exact symbols, ten unique provider-symbol evaluations, zero routed actions, and execution authority none.
Start a fresh continuous ledger without resuming the predecessor run.
Freeze the new run ID and initial ledger prefix before starting route lifecycle watchers.
Require cumulative heartbeat and entry-delay integrity; any technical gap invalidates aggregate frequency and profitability claims.
Keep every live strategy, route, side, exit, sizing, leverage, and risk setting unchanged.

success_metrics.technical: one uninterrupted implementation-stable observer window with complete eight-symbol and ten-route coverage and zero actions
success_metrics.diagnostic: at least one technically resolved source-compatible lifecycle per configured side before any directional diagnosis
success_metrics.change_recommendation: at least ten technically complete source-compatible lifecycles per route, at least three per configured side, exact costs and largest-winner sensitivity

failure_triggers: Any source hash differs before the smoke or continuous process starts.
Any observer row is armed, carries execution authority, or contains a routed action, order, or fill.
Any heartbeat gap exceeds a configured route entry-delay bound.
Any future, duplicate, missing-provider, or incomplete-candle decision appears.
Any result is pooled with the invalid predecessor aggregate window.
Any live strategy or risk configuration changes without explicit human approval.
